Worked Example: What Do I Need on the Final?

Suppose homework is 20% of your grade (you have 92), the midterm is 30% (you scored 78) and the final is worth 50%. Your points so far are 0.20 × 92 + 0.30 × 78 = 41.8. To finish with an 85, you need a final score of (85 − 41.8) ÷ 0.50 = 86.4%.

Checks Before You Rely on It

  • Make sure the weights add up to 100%.
  • Confirm whether your instructor drops the lowest score or rounds up.
  • If the needed score is above 100, the target is not reachable without extra credit.

Next Step

Convert grades into a GPA with the GPA calculator; for percentages, the percentage calculator is handy.

extra_faqs.q: How do I calculate a weighted grade?
extra_faqs.a: Multiply each category score by its weight, then add them. Weights should total 100%.

extra_faqs.q: What grade do I need on the final to get an A?
extra_faqs.a: Enter your current grade, the final's weight and the grade you want; the calculator solves for the score needed.

extra_faqs.q: Can I still pass if I failed the midterm?
extra_faqs.a: Possibly, depending on the weights. Enter your scores to see what the remaining work must be.
